summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers to delegate to them. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32, renamed output_path to output_dir in the in-repo callers, and added or updated five test files. Nothing was run or committed: tests, flake8, and the pinned ignite attach behavior are all unverified, and the changes were checked only by reading the code.
